_comment: Slakh2100 validation split, held out from training, from the silence-filtered encode of 2026-09-08: 56 items, not the 270 tracks in the split -- the rest were dropped as silent over the encoded window (see experiments/01-streamgen-conditioning/04-silence-filtering.md). Every item is exactly 144 latent frames ~= 13.3s (pre-encoded with --sample_size 587853 --pad), so 'latent_crop_length' matches the stored length and nothing is cropped or silence-padded; it was 1024 for the old whole-track encode, which would now pad each item with ~880 frames of silence. random_crop stays off so every arm is scored on byte-identical frames -- scripts/eval_streamgen.py takes a deterministic centred sub-window of --eval_frames (default 256) from this, which at 144 stored frames means the whole item; pass --eval_frames 144 explicitly and remember that --context_seconds 8 then leaves only ~5.4s to score. The old path /data/scratch-fast/snnithya/sao-3/data/slakh-streamgen-preencoded/validation/ predates the silence fix and is 20% duplicated tracks; do not point this back at it. Do not train on this config.
